text: The maximum responsivity of an ideal (η = 1) photodiode at 1550 nm is about 1.25 A/W.
explanation: True: R_max = eλ/(hc) with η = 1 gives ≈ 1.25 A/W at 1550 nm, and real Ge-on-Si detectors reach ~0.8–1.0 A/W. Responsivity rises with wavelength (up to the absorption cutoff) because each longer-wavelength photon carries less energy, yielding more electrons per watt.
